thesis.headline: Apparel brands that sell wholesale and DTC want one system
thesis.subline: Many juggle middleware, a separate B2B portal and a standalone WMS

thesis.headline: Uphance is set to win as brands drop disconnected tools
thesis.subline: B2B orders cut live stock in one system, so brands add retailers, not staff

thesis.headline: Help Uphance grow with outbound sales and AI
thesis.subline: We add outbound to the sales-led model and build AI into the product

market.subtitle: Wholesale and DTC apparel brands need one system for B2B orders, stock and the warehouse

competitors.name: AIMS360
competitors.rationale: Sells to wholesale, DTC and retail brands and runs warehousing, EDI and accounting in one ERP

competitors.name: Sync (iSync Solutions)
competitors.rationale: Built only for apparel and footwear brands, with B2B, warehousing and accounting in one cloud platform

competitors.name: ApparelMagic
competitors.rationale: Picked for DTC and wholesale brands, but its scope lists sales, inventory, purchasing and production without a warehouse module

competitors.name: BlueCherry
competitors.rationale: Serves manufacturers through retailers and is chosen when warehouse and manufacturing depth matters

competitors.name: Aptean Apparel ERP
competitors.rationale: Often serves larger, process-heavy firms and covers warehousing and financials

competitors.name: Ai2000
competitors.rationale: Serves wholesalers, manufacturers and retailers with warehouse and financials on an Oracle platform

competitors.name: WFX
competitors.rationale: Aimed at brands and manufacturers with PLM, MES and traceability ahead of warehouse tools

our_take.headline: Uphance runs B2B orders, Shopify and the warehouse from one stock pool
points: Enterprise suites are built for makers and big programs
Lighter brand tools leave the warehouse to add-ons
